name: HiPhO
intro: HiPhO 论文快照使用 2024-2025 年 7 项物理奥赛的 13 套官方试卷评估 (M)LLM，包含 360 道题、519 个小题；每个题解对均经专家核验，7 套考试提供官方步骤评分细则。当前官方数据树已在论文后加入 CPhO 2025，因此论文题量不应直接视为可变发布树的当前题量。
org: Shanghai AI Laboratory, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen
build_method: 官方试卷OCR, 题解索引匹配, 全量专家核验, 评分细则结构化, 多维标注
metric: 考试总分, 答案级与步骤级得分, 金银铜牌等级
task_type: 开放式问答, 选择题
eval_feature: 官方评分细则, 部分分, 多解取最高分, 多模态, 人机奖牌对比
scale: 13套试卷, 360道题, 519个小题；7套含评分细则
build_method_en: Official-exam OCR, question-answer index matching, complete expert verification, marking-scheme structuring, multidimensional annotation
eval_feature_en: Official marking schemes, partial credit, best-of-multiple solutions, multimodal input, human medal comparison
intro_en: The HiPhO paper snapshot evaluates (M)LLMs on 13 official papers from seven 2024-2025 physics Olympiads and contains 360 problems and 519 subquestions. Experts verify every QA pair and seven exams include official step-level marking schemes. The current official data tree added CPhO 2025 after the paper, so the paper counts are not presented as counts for the mutable release head.
scale_en: 13 exam papers, 360 problems, 519 subquestions; 7 papers include marking schemes
metric_en: Exam score, answer- and step-level score, Gold/Silver/Bronze level

drawio_review_note: Reviewed against arXiv:2509.07894v4 Sections 3.1-4 and Appendices A.1-A.2, the paper-era public GitHub tree b7f4814, current GitHub head 8db13ae, and Hugging Face revision 8e196c0. The paper snapshot selects 13 exams from seven influential 2024-2025 physics competitions based on influence and human-score availability. Official PDFs are converted to Markdown by OCR while preserving LaTeX, questions and answers are index-matched, and experts verify every QA pair. Seven exams provide official marking schemes and four support multiple official solutions; context completion, subquestion structuring, unit specification, and multidimensional annotation yield 360 problems and 519 subquestions in the paper snapshot. Answer scoring uses a rule-based math verifier followed by Gemini-2.5-Flash for failed equivalent matches; step scoring awards partial credit and the problem score is the maximum of answer- and step-level scores before exam totals map to medal thresholds. Current 8db13ae and HF 8e196c0 add CPhO 2025 after the paper, so paper counts are not assigned to the mutable current release. OCR intermediates and expert-review logs are not present in the pinned public trees.
